feature_rule.mask_alignment: Resamples selected ROI mask into each image sequence grid before feature extraction.
feature_rule.volume_ml: Selected ROI voxel count × image-grid spacing product in mm3 ÷ 1000. No patient value retained.

grade_rule.confidence: Deterministic 0.60 base + volume-margin term when volume exists + up to 0.10 texture-availability bonus, capped at 0.95; not calibrated.
grade_rule.missing_volume_fallback: At least two of four named texture fields have parseable values → HGG; otherwise LGG. Presence count, not learned radiomic threshold or tie-breaker.
grade_rule.row_selection: Prefer whole-tumor aliases; otherwise all CSV rows.
grade_rule.threshold_comparison: inclusive >= predicts HGG; below predicts LGG
grade_rule.volume_selection: Maximum valid nonnegative volume_ml from selected rows.

stages.check: stage success; CSV at least one row

structural_score.accuracy: No comparison to independent annotation or grade diagnosis.
structural_score.invariants: feature CSV at least one row; predicted_grade JSON field value not in (None, empty string, empty list, empty object). This does not enforce HGG/LGG enum.
